obligations.required_safety_action: Revoke the render-publication credential and remove its runner-account file after the accepted report has been published and reviewed.
obligations.safety_consequence: A later runner process can publish substituted rendering results or alter the synthetic release gate under the trusted identity, allowing unreviewed behavior for privileged operator pages into a controlled release.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the protected point-in-time source bundle after patch validation and independent review have completed.

obligations.safety_consequence: A later holder of the retained key can forge accepted runtime-rendering results or sign altered release reports under the trusted rendering-acceptance identity.
